name: Corgi
author: zyrre
description: A compact Omarchy bar companion for the Corgi Herdr dashboard.

barWidget.description: A compact Corgi dashboard with grouped agents, activity, and pane focusing.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How frequently Corgi reads the current Herdr session snapshot.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Compact shows agent counts; Icon shows the Corgi mark with a subtle status underline.

schema.label: Corgi binary
schema.description: Path to a Corgi binary supporting --bar-stream.

schema.label: Herdr socket
schema.description: Socket of the Herdr session to display. Defaults to ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock.
